messages:
marie (AE): FYI incoming ask from AcmeBank. They want a short POC demonstrating BYOK using their CloudHSM and need clarity on: rotation windows, expected latency impact during peak QPS, and any pricing delta for reserved pool + HSM ops. Can eng/sales-eng weigh in?

tara (Sales-Engineer): We can support BYOK via two paths: (1) KMS proxy where Redwood manages KEK and you upload wrapped keys to CloudHSM, or (2) direct BYOHSM where calls hit customer's HSM for unwrap/sign ops. For latency: unwrap on HSM per new session adds ~5-25ms depending on region. We strongly recommend KV/prefix caching for session tokens and client-side KEK caching.

sam (SRE): Agree on caching. Also callout: network egress and TLS mutual auth to their HSM endpoints will add some jitter; if they put HSM in same cloud region we'll see lower median. Need their VPC peering details and egress IP whitelist.

jack (Solutions): Quick pricing sketch: BYOHSM path = base Dedicated node + HSM proxy connector + ops premium. Ballpark: +$6k/month added to a small reserved pool, plus per-HSM request billing if we proxy unwraps. If customer hosts HSM and we talk to it directly, add support/SLAs fee ($2-3k/mo). Will confirm exact numbers with finance.

marie (AE): Thanks. They also asked about rotation — can we do live rotation without downtime?

tara (Sales-Engineer): Yes — we support dual-key rollout with overlap. Typical flow:
```
1) Deploy new kek/key version alongside current.
2) Serve both keys for write/read for N hours (audit window).
3) Cutover reads to new key, continue writes for a grace period.
4) Revoke old key after verification.
```
We can make the overlap configurable (15m — 48h). For HSM-backed keys, must ensure both key versions available in HSM cluster; some HSM vendors need key import choreography.

sam (SRE): Operational constraints: if they insist on a sub-5s rotation window we need pre-warmed cache and possibly a short throttling window. For high-QPS customers we recommend staged rollout + canary on 1-2 routes.

security-bot: Reminder — include answers for these items in the security questionnaire: key lifecycle diagram, key import/export controls, HSM attestation frequency, rotation policy, and proof of zero-knowledge handling.

marie (AE): Great. Action items: 1) tara to draft a one-page POC runbook with network checklist & rotation steps (ETA EOD tomorrow). 2) jack to confirm pricing delta with finance and provide a conservative range. 3) sam to request VPC/peering info from AcmeBank and list firewall rules. 4) sec-bot/infra to add required items to the security questionnaire.

jack (Solutions): I'll loop in finance now, expect initial numbers by EOD. :thumbsup:

tara (Sales-Engineer): Starting runbook now — will include a small config snippet for the HSM connector:
```yaml
hsm_connector:
  endpoint: "hsm.acmebank.internal:443"
  mTLS_cert: "<cert>"
  cache_ttl_ms: 120000
  rotation_overlap: 3600  # seconds
```
Will note estimated latencies per region.

sam (SRE): If they share sample traffic profile (p50/p90 tokens per second) we can simulate and give a more precise latency delta.

marie (AE): I'll ask for the traffic profile and VPC diagrams in my next email. Thanks everyone. :pray: 

security-bot: Logged task #SLS-4721 for security questionnaire items and assigned to security lead.

jack (Solutions): FYI — one potential enterprise blocker they mentioned: procurement needs explicit indemnity around key custody. We may need legal to draft an addendum.

marie (AE): Noted — I'll start a legal thread. If any other blockers or gotchas, drop them here.

tara (Sales-Engineer): Minor gotcha: some older HSM firmware versions don't support wrapped key import with AES-KW; will add a compatibility note to the runbook.

marie (AE): Perfect. Closing loop for now — will update thread after I hear back from AcmeBank. :eyes:
